children: Vitesse Energy acquired a set of non-operated oil and gas assets in the Denver-Julesburg Basin for $26 million.

The company said Wednesday it expects the acquisition, which closed on Tuesday and has a June 1 effective date, to be immediately accretive to earnings, free cash flow, and net asset value on a per-share basis.
It also said it hedged much of the acquired production through 2030 using commodity derivative contracts to support underwritten returns.

The assets are mainly located in Weld County, Colo., and are entirely operated by Chevron. They are expected to produce around 900 barrels of oil equivalent per day on a two-stream basis, Vitesse said.
"This transaction adds a high-quality, predominantly proved developed producing asset base operated by Chevron," Chief Executive Officer Jamie Benard said.
